description: Record a call with one of your leads, optionally setting a follow-up. Some outcomes also move the lead's stage (won, trial_started, appointment_booked, not_interested, do_not_call). Two-step: draft, then confirm.

confirm.description: Leave false to get a draft of the change. Only set true after the user has seen the draft and approved it.

follow_up_at.description: When to follow up, as an ISO 8601 date-time with timezone, e.g. 2026-10-09T10:00:00-05:00.

name: log_call
title: Log a call
